positioning.basis: sum of disclosed positions at or above 0.5% of shares outstanding, aggregated over sellers

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of twelve ESTIMATED prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. anchor_quality.basis: magnitude: realised vol plus an estimated-cadence reaction history, capped at 0.5 because neither is an option-implied move. direction: how many of the three positioning components resolved, capped at 0.60 because none of them is 25-delta skew.

The company held the plan at Q1 'due to Middle East materials uncertainty' and on 07-28 said it would revise 'if judged necessary'.

The current 30-yen plan is a 57% payout on stale EPS and would fall to about 40% on revised NP.

evidence.why_not_priced: The yield is 5.07% on the 30-yen plan at 592 (kabuyoho). A raise to 35-40 yen would take it to 5.9-6.8% at an unchanged price. The register is retail and margin-heavy and has bought yield before (the April limit-up). If a raise were priced, the stock would already have re-rated toward a 6% yield after the 07-28 gain.
evidence.independence: Partly the same fact as finding 1: a raise is conditional on the profit upgrade. It is kept separate because it is a separate board decision with its own reaction history, and it is sized small for the overlap.

evidence.text: The first FY27 guide comes with this release, and management has pre-signalled it will meet or beat the mid-term-plan path. The July Q3 briefing said the pipeline is sufficient for the mid-term plan's FY27 operating-profit target. A high-margin advisory deal was moved out of FY26 into FY27, not lost. In the 2026-07-22 Q&A the company answered a question about upward revisions with '早期の中期経営計画達成' and said FY27 sales would centre on balance-sheet investment deals. Three new purchases of property for resale settle on 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-06: Fukuoka at no less than 30% of FY25 net assets, and two Yamanashi properties together at no less than 30%.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the last full-year print (2025-10-14, after the close) the FY26 guide was +80% operating profit plus the new mid-term plan. The stock opened +10% (7,520 against 6,840), closed -5.85%, fell another 5.75% and 4.28% over the next two sessions, and a public offering followed on 2025-10-30. At Q3 (2026-07-14) a dividend raise plus confidence in the full-year plan gave +12.27%. At Q2 (2026-04-13) a revenue upgrade with a weak quarter gave -13.18%.
evidence.why_not_priced: At JPY20.7bn market cap the stock trades at 13x the one analyst's forward EPS and about 16x a mid-term-path FY27 net profit of roughly JPY1.3bn. A believed guide at or above the plan path would put it above the 4,300-4,400 seen in late September and early October. Instead it is -6% over five days. One analyst covers it and there is no FY27 consensus beyond that one number. The risk to this finding is that the guide lands between the mid-term path and the analyst, which this name has sold before.
evidence.independence: Separate documents point the same way. The 2026-09-25 acquisition notices (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925540071/, https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925540077/) show the FY27 deal pipeline.
